PDF Out-of-Core Construction of Sparse Voxel Octrees - KU Leuven
The main problem with converting massively large and highly detailed triangle-based scenes into sparse voxel octrees is the size of the intermediate high-resolution voxel data, which typically exceeds the available memory. In this paper, we present an out-of-core algorithm for constructing a sparse voxel octree from a triangle mesh.
